description: This file contains test cases for the 'enablePluginInConfig' function, using the 'vitest' testing framework. It verifies the behavior of plugin enabling/disabling, allowlist and denylist handling, and built-in channel configuration within an OpenClaw plugin system.

methods.name: function expectEnableResult( expectEnableResult
methods.description: A helper function that calls enablePluginInConfig and checks if the result's enabled status matches expected and invokes an assertion callback.

methods.name: function expectEnabledAllowlist( expectEnabledAllowlist
methods.description: Checks that the allowlist in the result matches the expected list.

methods.name: function expectBuiltInChannelEnabled(result: ReturnType<typeof enablePluginInConfig>) { expectBuiltInChannelEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that built-in channels (telegram) are enabled in the configuration.

methods.description: Checks built-in channels are enabled and optionally verifies the allowlist.
